text:
ana: Customer reported runtime failures when using our SDK in Cloudflare Workers: `Buffer is not defined`, `crypto.randomBytes is not a function`, and `require is not defined`. Need a short troubleshooting blurb we can paste in support replies.

ben: Quick checklist we can share: 1) use the edge ESM bundle (import from '@redwood/inference/edge'), 2) build with platform="browser" or target="webworker" so bundlers don't leave Node shims, 3) ensure TS lib includes "webworker" not "node".

oli: Also add a short explainer about why: Workers are web platform runtimes, not Node. They only provide globalThis.fetch, Headers, ReadableStream, and globalThis.crypto. Node built-ins (Buffer, fs, net, node:crypto) won't work.

ana: (typo) ana: We should include quick fixes: show a tsconfig snippet and a tiny worker example.

ben: TS snippet: `{"compilerOptions":{"lib":["es2021","webworker"],"module":"esnext","moduleResolution":"bundler"}}`

oli: Worker example (very short):
```
import { createEdgeClient } from '@redwood/inference/edge'
const client = createEdgeClient({ fetch: globalThis.fetch, crypto: globalThis.crypto, retry: 0 })
export default { async fetch(req){ const id = req.headers.get('x-idempotency-key')||crypto.randomUUID(); const r = await client.generate({prompt:'hi', headers:{'x-idempotency-key':id}}); return new Response(JSON.stringify(r)); } }
```

ana: (ana): Good. Also call out a package.json exports recommendation so `import '@redwood/inference'` doesn't accidentally pull node-only code. Example minimal exports: `{".":{"import":"./dist/edge/index.mjs","default":"./dist/node/index.cjs"}}`.

ben: For DX, we should NOT polyfill globals by default. Offer an opt-in `@redwood/edge-shims` for tests/examples that provides tiny helpers (safe Buffer wrapper, randomBytes -> crypto.getRandomValues). Put a big warning in the README.

oli: Retry behavior: edge default => `retries: 0`. Add docs advising idempotency headers for callers who retry outside the worker.

devex-bot: Reminder: open PR with example worker, tsconfig snippet, exports change, and a CI smoke build of the example (esbuild/rollup) to catch regressions.

ana: I'll draft the support blurb and example and open the PR.
